## Purpose

Weekly dependency update ahead of the weekly AMIP run. This week ClimaAtmos and RRTMGP are updated (not ClimaLand).

## Content

Both `experiments/AMIP/Manifest-v1.11.toml` and `experiments/CMIP/Manifest-v1.11.toml` now use the same versions of the updated packages. Every other package is held fixed.

| Package | AMIP | CMIP | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| ClimaAtmos | 0.42.11 → **0.42.12** | 0.42.10 → **0.42.12** | new release (CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl#4855) |
| ClimaParams | 1.1.11 → **1.1.15** | 1.1.9 → **1.1.15** | latest; ClimaAtmos 0.42.12 requires `ClimaParams ≥ 1.1.13` |
| CloudMicrophysics | 0.40.0 → 0.41.0 | 0.39.0 → 0.41.0 | required by ClimaAtmos 0.42.12 (`CloudMicrophysics = "0.41"`) |
| RRTMGP | 1.0.0 → **1.0.1** | 1.0.0 → **1.0.1** | new release ([notes](https://github.com/CliMA/RRTMGP.jl/releases/tag/v1.0.1): binary search in `loc_lower`) |
| OpenLibm_jll | 0.8.1+2 → 0.8.5+0 | 0.8.1+2 → 0.8.5+0 | Julia 1.11.9 stdlib |

The CMIP manifest's `julia_version` also moves from 1.11.3 to 1.11.9. ClimaLand stays at 1.12.2.

ClimaAtmos 0.42.12 is the registered release (JuliaRegistries/General#169520), not a branch.

ClimaParams 1.1.15 only adds two parameters for limiting microphysics heating rates (CliMA/ClimaParams.jl#325).

Note: ClimaParams 1.1.14 changes the default `EDMF_interface_entr_efficiency` from 0.4 to 0.0, which affects runs using prognostic EDMF.

## Not included

`experiments/AMIP/Manifest.toml` and `experiments/CMIP/Manifest.toml` (Julia 1.10) are not updated. On `main` they no longer resolve against the current projects: for example, the manifests have ClimaCalibrate 0.4.0 and 0.2.2, but #2130 set the compat to `ClimaCalibrate = "0.6"`. Fixing them needs a broad update, which is out of scope here.
